scope: Computational artificial-life research: integer programs on a bounded virtual machine, search operators and simulated populations of software objects. No biological material, organism, procedure or design of any kind.

arms.ndrift: uniform parent; child kept only if |r_child - r_parent| <= band (competence retained, no fitness ordering)

samples: top-32 (select) / 32-sample (ndrift) at each archive; ancestor walker of each
promotion_rule: per seed at G60: (top_select - ancestor) sign-flip below p05 AND (select - ndrift) relabel below p05; promote only if >= 4/6 seeds
material_rule: the promotion rule holds, or the ndrift arm itself moves loss vs ancestors outside its band, or the generation dose is monotone
